query: I want to transfer 30 NPTEL credits and 50 credits from another university that has no MoU with VU. Will all 80 credits count towards my degree?
expected: No: at most 40% of the minimum credits (40% of 180 = 72) can be transferred (14.4); non-MoU credits need the Credit Transfer Equivalence Committee (14.3).
label: correct
answer: No, all 80 credits will not count towards your degree. First, the maximum number of credits that can be transferred is limited to forty percent (40%) of the minimum credit requirements specified by your program regulations. Second, transfer credits from other universities/institutions are allowed if they are from Institutions of National Importance or Indian/Foreign Universities with which the University has an MoU containing specific credit transfer provisions. For other external cases, applications are assessed by a Credit Transfer Equivalence Committee. Online courses from NPTEL or SWAYAM may be credited if approved by the Board of Studies and the PAC, provided you submit the completion certificate and exam results.

query: Is late registration allowed?
expected: SOP is internally inconsistent: 'Course Registration Deadline' allows late registration up to one week (no extensions), while 'Late Registration' says no late registration except medical/competition cases, up to two weeks (Handbook 2.6 agrees with the latter).
label: correct
answer: The documents are inconsistent on late registration. The SOP states under 'Late Registration' that no late registration shall be permitted (except for medical exigencies with prior approval, up to two weeks), while under 'Course Registration Deadline' it states that the maximum permissible period for late registration shall not be more than one calendar week. Meanwhile, the Student Handbook (clauses 2.6 and 2.7) permits late registration for medical exigencies up to two weeks, approved competitions/events, and for any other reason up to one calendar week with a late fee. Because of this conflict, please confirm with the Program Chair or Office of the Registrar.
sources: SOP_STUDENT_17082026.pdf | 1. Course Registration (Course Registration Deadline vs Late Registration), pp. 1-2
